name: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long PURR ETF
name_en: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long PURR ETF
desc: The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that seeks to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. It aims to achieve this daily percentage change for a single day, and not for any other period. It is non-diversified.
